summary: syscall_hosttest.c, the state checks of connect, the framebuffer calls, the clocks, the sleeps, the interval timers and alarm, with 70 faults in private copies of rach2/sys/syscall.c and syscall_net.c

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host && cp -R rach2 ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -g -O1 -ffreestanding -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/arch/x86 -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/arch/i686 -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/proc tests/host/syscall_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kstring.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kctypes.c -o ${WORK}/syscall_hosttest
